metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a narrower specialization of peer skill 1bfee323 (Reserve space for images using width, height, or aspect-ratio). Both target the same objective (prevent layout shift for images) and semantic capability (pre-allocating space before image load). The candidate focuses specifically on aspect-ratio-derived calculation as one method, while the peer skill covers the broader capability including direct width/height attributes and CSS aspect-ratio property. The peer skill is more general and already encompasses the candidate's narrower approach. Merging consolidates overlapping image space-reservation guidance into the existing, more comprehensive skill.
